content: Within the mining sector, identifying the primary platforms that facilitated procurement during the 2020 to 2024 period presents certain analytical challenges, as much of the readily available data provides either future projections or snapshots of current tenders in June 2026 rather than a comprehensive historical overview. While its broad utility as a tender aggregation site is clearly evident, the absence of a verifiable historical overview for the 2020 to 2024 timeframe necessitates further archival research to fully comprehend the mining tender dynamics of that era [30] . Overview of Procurement Dynamics and Tender Portals in South Africa Category Details Region South Africa Key Sectors Mining, Industrial Maintenance, Engineering Analysis Timeframe 2020-2024 Focus Area Key tender portals and procurement dynamics Data Source: Google Search Key Tender Portals for Mining and Industrial Maintenance Projects in South Africa Focus Area Project Type Relevant Period Mining Procurement & Tenders 2020-2024 Industrial Maintenance Procurement Trends 2020-2024 Engineering Tender Dynamics 2020-2024 Data Source: Google Search CIDB Grades Relevant to Engineering and Structural Steel Tenders The Construction Industry Development Board plays a pivotal role in regulating engineering tenders within South Africa, functioning primarily through its comprehensive grading system that meticulously evaluates contractors based on their financial and technical capabilities [1, 2]. Despite the critical importance of understanding historical trends within this grading framework, obtaining a retrospective analytical overview of engineering tenders in South Africa between 2020 and 2024 presents substantial challenges.
